name: omp
description: Oh My Paper research harness for Kimi Code: memory system, Codex delegation, and pipeline commands for academic research projects.
systemPrompt: 本环境安装了 Oh My Paper (OMP) 学术研究插件。若当前项目包含 .pipeline/ 目录，说明它是 OMP 研究项目：开始研究任务前先读取 .pipeline/.session-context.md 与 .pipeline/memory/execution_context.md 恢复上下文，用 /omp:plan 查看整体状态，不要重置已有记忆文件。无 .pipeline/ 目录时忽略本条。

interface.shortDescription: AI 学术研究全流程 harness：调研 → 选题 → 实验 → 写作 → 评审
interface.longDescription: Run literature surveys, ideation, experiments, and paper writing inside Kimi Code with pipeline commands, project roles, persistent project memory, and optional Codex delegation.
